# Getting help

- **Installing a mod:** each project's README lists what you need and how to install it.
- **Something doesn't work:** open a **Bug report** issue in the project's repository. Include your log and the exact versions you use.
- **You have an idea:** open a **Feature request** issue.
- **A security issue:** follow our [security policy](SECURITY.md) instead of opening an issue.

Our projects are made in our spare time, so replies can take a few days.
